name: Lone Wolf Love
source:
Van, a camping enthusiast, finds himself stranded in a snowy forest and stumbles upon a creepy house where he meets Baal, a werewolf. Despite discovering Baal's true identity, Van decides to stay.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
范是一名露营爱好者，发现自己被困在白雪皑皑的森林中，并偶然发现了一所令人毛骨悚然的房子，在那里他遇到了狼人巴尔。尽管发现了巴尔的真实身份，范还是决定留下来。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
